**Memberships are open** 🧡
SculptForge stays free and open source. Memberships fund development and come with real perks:
• **Supporter** ($5/mo): your name in the credits, in the app and on the site.
• **Insider** ($20/mo): the monthly Supporter Pack of brushes and alphas, a vote on what gets built next, and credits. Insiders will get each release about two weeks early, starting with SculptForge 1.0.
• **Studio** ($150/mo): Insider for up to 10 artists, priority triage of your pipeline bugs, and your logo on the site.
Add your Discord username at checkout and you'll get your role here.
→ https://sculptforge.app/support.html
